name: search_datasets
description: Search datasets published on Colombia's open-data portal datos.gov.co. Returns each dataset's Socrata 4x4 id (e.g. "gt2j-8ykr"), name, and description (Spanish). Use the id with dataset_columns and query_dataset. Query terms can be Spanish or English (e.g. "covid", "presupuesto", "contratos").

name: dataset_columns
description: List the columns of a datos.gov.co dataset: field name (used in SoQL $select/$where), human label, and data type. Call this before query_dataset so you know which fields exist. datasetId is the Socrata 4x4 code from search_datasets.

name: query_dataset
description: Query rows from a datos.gov.co dataset using SoQL. datasetId is the Socrata 4x4 code from search_datasets. SoQL clauses: $select (columns / aggregates like "count(*)"), $where (SQL-like filter, e.g. "departamento_nom='BOGOTA' AND edad > 60"), $order ("count desc"), $group, $q (full-text across the row). Use dataset_columns first to learn field names. Returns an array of row objects keyed by field name. Default $limit is 50 (Socrata max per page is 50000).

$q.description: Full-text search across the whole row.

name: co_fic_search
description: Find a Colombian collective investment fund (fondo de inversión colectiva, FIC) by name. Accepts the fund or the fiduciaria / management company in any case, with or without accents, in any word order (e.g. "Fiducoldex Capital Inteligente", "fondo abierto bancolombia"). Returns ranked candidates with entity, fund name and fund_code, or found:false with the closest fund names when nothing matches. Source: Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia.

name.description: Fund name, or fund manager name, e.g. "Fiducoldex Capital Inteligente".

name: co_fic_unit_value
description: Unit value (valor de la unidad) and returns (rentabilidad diaria/mensual/semestral/anual) for a Colombian collective investment fund (FIC), per participation class, with fund size and number of investors. Give the fund by name (forgiving match) or by fund_code from co_fic_search. Default is the latest published day; pass date (YYYY-MM-DD) for one day or from/to for a history. An unknown fund returns found:false with close fund names; an ambiguous name returns the candidates to choose from. Source: Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia, FIC daily series.

fund.description: Fund name, e.g. "Fiducoldex Capital Inteligente". Optional if fund_code is given.

fund_code.description: Fund code from co_fic_search (exact; skips name matching).

date.description: One day, YYYY-MM-DD (the regulator publishes with a few days lag).

participation_class.description: Only this participation class (tipo de participación), e.g. 450.

limit.description: Max rows when a range is requested (default 60, max 400).
